name: Quadratic assignment, QAPLIB tai80b
description: Quadratic assignment problem, QAPLIB instance tai80b: given two 80 x 80 integer matrices a and b, find a permutation p of 0..79 that minimises the cost, the sum over all i and j of a[i, j] * b[p[i], p[j]]. In the usual reading one matrix holds the flows between facilities and the other the distances between locations, and p assigns the one to the other; the cost formula is what is scored.
contract: solve(a, b) -> permutation p of 0..n-1 (a list of n integers, each exactly once). a and b are the first and second matrix of the QAPLIB file (int64 arrays of shape (n, n), passed as copies). Score: the exact integer cost, the sum over all i and j of a[i, j] * b[p[i], p[j]], minimized.
notes: tai80b.dat from the QAPLIB deposit (Edinburgh DataShare, doi 10.7488/ds/3428, CC BY 4.0)

Taillard random asymmetric instance with 80 facilities, generated to resemble real-life instances: a symmetric distance-type matrix of Euclidean flavour and a sparse, non-uniform, asymmetric flow matrix (QAPLIB: 'asymmetric and randomly generated').
Same evaluator contract as the existing QAPLIB tasks tai256c, tho150 and wil100 in autoresearch-tasks.
The record construction is public, so a candidate can embed the QAPLIB solution file; compare only genuinely searched results.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Find a minimum-cost Koopmans-Beckmann quadratic assignment of 80 facilities to 80 locations for the QAPLIB instance tai80b, which is not solved to optimality.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: The quadratic assignment problem models facility and hospital layout, keyboard design, backboard wiring and the generation of grey patterns. It is NP-hard and hard in practice: QAPLIB instances above about 30 facilities are mostly unsolved, and the best known solutions of the larger ones have stood for many years, so a cheaper permutation is a new best known solution of a standard open instance.

papers.title: Robust taboo search for the quadratic assignment problem
papers.task_relation: QAPLIB credits the best known solution of tai80b to robust tabu search (Ro-TS), which this paper introduces; tai80b is an asymmetric random Taillard 'b' instance.
papers.primary_goal: Introduce the robust tabu search heuristic for the quadratic assignment problem and report results on test instances.

papers.title: Comparison of iterative searches for the quadratic assignment problem
papers.task_relation: QAPLIB cites a 1994 Taillard report for the Taillard 'b' instances; this paper, which describes the generator of random instances with Euclidean-type distances and non-uniform flows, appears to be its published version.
papers.primary_goal: Compare iterative search methods for the quadratic assignment problem on uniform random, structured and real-life instances, and describe a generator of more realistic random instances.
